summary: Kraft Heinz is american worldwide food company formed by the merger of Kraft Foods and Heinz, founded in 2015. Type: listed company. About 36,000 employees (Wikidata). Revenue $26.5 billion (2022). Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 89% of its 9 jobs here don't ask for Dutch. News, last 3 months: 2 about funding; 2 about acquisitions.

culture.text: Says it wants ambitious, curious high performers, challenges the ordinary and celebrates both wins and failures.
Staff mostly studied business, marketing, economics and finance.

open.text: Kraft Heinz Amsterdam B.V. and Kraft Heinz GCOE B.V. are IND recognised sponsors.

growth.text: Staff fell from 38,757 in 2020 to 36,000 in 2021.
Revenue was USD 26.485 billion in 2022, with a net profit of USD 2.363 billion.
Pushing new products around protein and fibre as its innovation drive gains steam.

worth_knowing.text: Its CEO says its legacy brands face cheaper competition.
Must face a lawsuit over allegedly misleading labels on a cheesecake snack.
Is suing insurers that refuse to cover lawsuits over processed foods.
